loose files at the launch_packages/pettripfinder root (<city>_proposed_authority_NNN.json, identity_resolutions.json) are UNCLASSIFIED / unrule'd and cost a broad run in whichever order commits them; commit them in the acquisition phase, not with the registration, and prefer markets/reports/ for run outputs

eleven test modules enumerate markets by hand (NOT_READY, SOURCE_READY_UNAUTHORIZED and similar tables edited by the Charlotte closure); under a narrow registration they go stale silently until the next broad run -- a test-hygiene debt, not a release-safety gap, and a registration that edits them is not data-only

the registration lane's own inputs (the market document, the proposed authority, the pin block) are stated, not derived; the proof holds each to the sealed package, so a wrong statement fails the registration rather than passing it
